decisive_items: bilateral facial nerve enhancement compatible with bilateral facial neuritis
bilateral lower motor neuron facial muscle weakness
inability to close her eyelids, and difficulty raising her eyebrows
response.rationale: The acute bilateral lower motor neuron facial palsy with MRI showing bilateral facial nerve enhancement directly indicates facial neuritis. The pre-existing grade 1 peripheral neuropathy and capillary leak are historical comorbidities but do not explain the focal cranial nerve imaging findings.

rejected.why: Explains prior severe edema but not the bilateral facial nerve palsy or MRI enhancement.
Stable pre-existing grade 1 peripheral neuropathy does not account for the new bilateral lower motor neuron facial weakness with facial nerve enhancement.
